summary: Removed 9 generated helpers from internal/cli/helpers.go that no command calls: requiredInputWaived, endpointPositionalArgs, endpointArgsUsageErr, endpointUsageLine, booleanSpaceFormPositionalErr, booleanNoValueFlags, hasChangedLocalFlags, retainCLIQueryParams and retainExplicitQueryParams. paginatedGet's comment no longer names retainCLIQueryParams.
reason: Dogfood reported all 9 as defined but never called (dead-functions WARN; scorecard dead_code 1/5). The generator emits them for typed endpoint commands, and this CLI's only generated endpoints (categories list and games) are replaced by offline commands, so nothing reaches them. A grep of every .go file, tests included, found no caller outside the removed set. Press retro candidate: emit these helpers only when a generated command uses them.
call_sites: // Every value that reaches this loop, including an operator-set false/0,
validated_outcome: go build, gofmt, go vet and go test -count=1 ./... green (14 packages); dogfood Dead Functions 0 (was 9), verdict PASS (was WARN). No live requests were made for this change.
